description: Original bot reactive-dispatch foundation tests: deterministic admission, dedupe, ambiguity lifecycle and failure preservation, with in-test fakes only.
isolationRationale: Coordinator read the complete test and four runtime implementation files plus the dispatch type definitions. Runtime chain is pure admission/dedupe/state logic over Maps/Sets, Date.now, node:crypto randomUUID and bounded real timers. Original in-test repository and gateway fakes are unchanged; no real dispatch, persistence, process, socket, filesystem, Electron, provider or credential operation is reached. MentuHostObservation is imported only as a type and erased; its source and further type-only dependencies are deliberately not staged. This is not a typecheck or a complete type import closure. No fake timer installation occurs; one test manually injects now().
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Both configurations use node. Execute this capsule with an explicit original installed Vitest 4.1.11 entry; runner receipts record the actual version/path.
The minimal capsule omits root renderer aliases, ORCA_FEATURE_WALL_ENABLED and the three DOM/host-port setup files; none is referenced by this source closure.

The capsule omits root execArgv webstorage/GC options and the Windows maxWorkers override, and uses default timeouts rather than root 30s test/60s hook timeouts. The 10/20ms real timers complete far inside any default. No webstorage, DOM, GC assertion or platform-dependent branch occurs in these files. This does not establish full source-environment equivalence.
typeOnlyImports: bot-reactive-dispatch-types imports MentuHostObservation from mentu-run-contract with import type; not loaded or staged. No typecheck claim.
dependencyClosureNote: Original test has 17 direct it() calls plus 12 actual table rows, independently counted by coordinator AST traversal before execution. Worker draft incorrectly counted 13 rows and used unsupported role:type plus no expectedTestCounts.tests; corrected before staging. Source assertions were never changed.
